notes: No model/GPU was started; all computations use complete raw records and recorded run controls.
All primary values were frozen before author analysis, cards, claims or synthesis for E113/E114 were read.
F switches all A cached evidence; R switches all contextualized B cached evidence available for query reading. R is not a fixed reader or pure direct label copying.
Absolute-amplitude interaction alone cannot establish nonadditivity; signed interaction is reported and positive in both confirmations.
K-only/V-only refer to direct edge interchange; active descendants and query states can change.
Native relation reconstruction diagnostics are reviewer POST-HOC and do not redefine primary readouts.

Mistral blockwise prefix encoding differs from whole literal-string encoding in every confirmation context: enc(newline-newline) has leading metaspace token, with 32 B-answer-scope tokens versus Qwen 16. The matched native/split controls concern the actual blockwise token stream.
